column1: # Static landmark catalogue for distant-zoom rivers.
# Matching is by normalized river names/aliases on OSM ways; Wikidata is not required.
# Lengths are approximate published river lengths and are used only to assign a stable display rank.
# Ranks: 1 >=3000 km, 2 >=1500 km, 3 >=750 km, 4 = shorter legacy/manual landmark.
# This file is intentionally maintained manually and may be refreshed infrequently.
